desc.p: This method allows the cache owner to update details of an existing geocache. Only the cache owner can modify a cache. At least one optional parameter must be provided.

req.name: cache_code
req.p: Code of the cache to update. The authenticated user must be the cache owner.

opt.name: cache_name
opt.p: New name for the cache (max 256 characters).

opt.name: size2
opt.p: New container size (none, nano, micro, small, regular, large, xlarge, other).

opt.name: status
opt.p: New cache status. Must be one of: Available, Temporarily unavailable, Archived.

opt.name: alt_wpts
opt.p: JSON array of waypoints. Replaces all existing waypoints with the provided list. Each waypoint must have: name, location (lat|lon), type, description.

opt.name: add_alt_wpts
opt.p: JSON array of waypoints to add without removing existing waypoints.

opt.name: remove_alt_wpts
opt.p: Pipe-separated list of waypoint names to remove (e.g., "P1|S1").

returns.p: A dictionary of the following structure:

li.p: success - true, if the cache was updated successfully.
message - status message for the user.
